from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial report containing the other payables line item."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this report belongs to")
    company_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities code if available in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    other_payables_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as written for other payables")
    other_payables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The other payables amount if reported; None if this document doesn't contain it")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the other payables figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
